$comment: Every screen from docs/mockups, in sidebar order. `/` opens the home screen chosen in Appearance. `look` is the look it was designed in (used by the 'Per screen' look); `milestone` is when it gets real content (docs/PLAN.md §9).

screens.label: Overview
screens.summary: Posture score, live indicator alerts, the newest exploited CVEs and every device at a glance.

screens.label: Fleet
screens.summary: Every device on the network, merged by MAC from ARP, Pi-hole, mDNS, nmap, agents and MVT.

screens.label: Targeted check
screens.summary: Check one IP, MAC, hostname, CVE or domain: scan profiles, a full dossier and a timeline.

screens.label: Pi-hole Sentinel
screens.summary: Hunt the Pi-hole query log for spyware and ADINT indicators, check coverage, push a denylist with a preview.

screens.label: CVEs & zero-days
screens.summary: Eleven feeds deduplicated, exploited bugs first, with the devices each one affects.

screens.label: This device
screens.summary: What applies to the screen you are reading this on: browser and OS CVEs, GPC, ad blocking, Starlink egress.

screens.label: Ad exposure
screens.summary: Citizen Lab's defender guidance as four scored pillars and a per-device checklist, with hardening kits.

screens.label: Indicators
screens.summary: The spyware and ADINT indicator set from zero-breach: where it came from, how it was verified, updates waiting for review, and exports for DNS filters, MVT and MISP.

screens.label: Baselines
screens.summary: Lockdown, Strict, Balanced and Essential, per device or network, with the sites each would block on your traffic.

screens.label: Blocklist library
screens.summary: Every DNS blocklist, categorised, auto-discovered, versioned and gated, served to Pi-hole.

screens.label: Evidence locker
screens.summary: zero-breach findings by evidence tier, gaps, chain of custody, STIX and MISP exports.

screens.label: Briefing
screens.summary: The daily or weekly digest in plain language, printable and emailed.

screens.label: BoxPilot
screens.summary: How this copy is managed by BoxPilot: the summary its agents read, approvals and backups.

screens.label: Activity
screens.summary: Every job and every change, with who did it and when.

screens.label: Appearance
screens.summary: Look, name, logo, accent, home screen and density.
